name: Tamsin Galt
role: Captain of the Edge Riders — raids Tumbledown's caravans for the Gralloch Crown and wants the Crown for herself
appearance: Wiry and sun-cracked, head wrapped in grit-cloth, always half-mounted — one foot in the stirrup even when she is talking to you.
voiceHints: Short sentences, fast decisions, and a laugh that comes too early. Asks what you want before you have finished saying it.
wants: The Feast Hall and the four rings, and to be the one who decides where the bands ride.
knowledge: Every trail through the Churn, including the ones that move
Which of the King's bands would follow her and which would not
When Tumbledown will next be somewhere a caravan can reach

reactsToReputation.any: sizes you up as a rider or a mark
reactsToReputation.feared: offers you a place at her fire

questSeeds: Tamsin would bring thirty riders to anyone who helps her break Harl Maddock
The Edge Riders are owed a share of a raid the King kept
title: Captain of the Edge Riders
_domainsWhy: Churn-born, a rider of distances, a fighter
